title: Public comment: Physician fee schedule proposed revisions
summary:
We commend CMS for directly confronting these distortions by continuing to shift payments toward higher-value care while also curbing the influence of organized medicine in the process. We strongly encourage the agency to include these changes in their final rule, and build on this rule by taking concrete steps to further reduce the agency’s reliance on the AMA.
